prompt: A recipe box web app: add recipes with ingredients and steps, tag and search them, scale servings, a printable view, data saved in the browser, works on a phone, keyboard accessible; with tests.

org.sizing: Balanced: a browser-only app with two real parts, the app logic with its keyboard accessibility and the visual system with phone and print layout, so two makers reporting to me, with one independent review at the end.

plan.goal: A recipe box web app: add recipes with ingredients and steps, tag and search them, scale servings, a printable view, data saved in the browser, works on a phone, keyboard accessible; with tests. Stack: Vite + React + TypeScript, Vitest and Testing Library, no backend. Extra: JSON export and import as a backup. Look: warm editorial cookbook (cream paper, serif headings, one accent colour, light and dark).

milestones.title: The recipe box works end to end
Looks right on a phone and on paper

tasks.title: Project setup: Vite, React, TypeScript and test tooling
Recipe types and tolerant browser storage
Design foundation: tokens, base styles and primitives
App state, accessibility helpers and the library view
Recipe editor: add and edit with ingredients and steps
Recipe detail with servings scaler and printable view
App shell, routing, backup UI and end-to-end flows
tasks.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

tasks.title: Style every screen: phone, dark mode, print
Fresh review of the whole result against the stakeholder's words
